lines.li: [them] My people haven't forgotten {FAVOURWHY}.
[us] We didn't do it to be owed anything.
[them,their:tribal] A gift is owed back all the same, and the elders know it.
[them,their:medieval] It's a debt of honor all the same, and we pay ours.
[them,their:industrial] It's on the books at home, and people there remember it.
[them,their:spacer] It's logged, and nobody where I come from leaves an entry open.
[them] All the same, we owe the colony, and we know it.
[them] I owe you for {FAVOURWHY}, and I haven't forgotten it.
[us] I'd do it again.
[them] Then I hope you'll let me pay it back someday.
[us] If I ever need something, you'll be the first I ask.
[them] The elders still tell of {FAVOURWHY} by the fire.
[us] I'd rather they told it than forgot it.
[them] A gift owed back is never forgotten among us.
[them] My lord says a debt of honor is the only kind worth paying promptly.
[us] We're in no hurry.
[them] Then name it when you're ready, and it will be done.
[them] Somebody at home wrote down {FAVOURWHY} and pinned it to the wall.
[us] Is that good or bad?
[them] Good, it means we owe you, and we pay our IOUs.
[them] There's an open entry in our records with your colony's name on it.
[us] What does it say?
[them] Credit owed, for {FAVOURWHY}.
[them] My house keeps a ledger of favors, and your colony's name is in it.
[us] I hope it's on the good side of the page.
[them] It's on the side we repay.
[us] We still owe your people for {FAVOURWHY}.
[them,tone:warm] Between friends it hardly counts as a debt.
[them,their:tribal] Then the fire will remember it, and so will we.
[them,their:medieval] Then it stands between us, as a debt of honor should.
[them,their:hightech] It's on the books, and it can stay there until we need it.
[them] We'll ask when we need something, not before.
[us] That's fair.
[them] You remember the help my people gave you?
[us] We do, and we know we owe you for it.
[them] Good, a debt remembered is half paid.
[them] Your colony still owes my people, I'd remind you.
[us] We haven't forgotten.
[them] My people called in what the colony owes us, and we're waiting on the answer.
[us] It's being talked over at the colony.
[them,tone:cool|tone:sour] We helped when you needed it, and talking is cheap.
[them] I hope the answer is yes.
[them] Your colony answered when my people called in the debt.
[us] We owed it.
[them] Plenty of people owe things, and fewer pay.
[them] My people asked the colony for help once, and got nothing.
[us] It was a hard season for us too.
[them] It was harder for us.
[them] My people let the colony down when it called in what we owed.
[us] We remember.
[them] Not everyone at home agreed with the answer, for what it's worth.
